title: Kedgeree
ingredients: 2 tbsp curry powder & 1 tbsp mustard seeds
steps: Boil eggs for 10 minutes, cool in water, peel and quarter them.
Poach haddock with bay leaves in covered pan for 5 minutes, then flake.
Cook rice in salted water for 10 minutes, drain and chill in fridge.
Melt ghee, sauté ginger, onion, garlic, spices, tomatoes and lemon juice.
Warm fish and rice in pan, gently fold in eggs, chilli and herbs.
Mix remaining coriander into yoghurt and serve alongside the kedgeree.
